Theme Songs for Silo, Linux amd64 and arm64.

Downloads exact ThemerrDB matches or selected URLs into validated movie and series directories. Includes preview, protected file publication, durable Autoscan delivery and owner discovery checks. Start with preview enabled and follow the included configuration guide.

Install through the Crowquillx plugin catalog or upload the matching raw binary. Tarballs include the manifest, configuration example and license notices. Verify downloads with `checksums.txt`.
